ctx.x: Let’s move on with the Golden Beams catalogue, because the level of productivity is astounding. February you release The Elephant Sleeps But Still Remembers.

“The Elephant Sleeps But Still Remembers” is one of my favorites of the projects that I did with Bill Frisell. While I was touring in 2000 with Keith Jarrett out in the Northwest, we played in Seattle, Washington, John Gilbreath…
